standard-dialogue.player: What are you doing here? Shouldn't you be looking after your glider?

standard-dialogue.npc: I'm pretty much retired these days old fellow. My test piloting days are over. I'm just relaxing here and enjoying the primal clash between man and man.

standard-dialogue.player: You're watching the duels then. Are you going to challenge someone yourself?

standard-dialogue.npc: I do find the duels entertaining to watch, but I suspect that actually being involved would be a lot less fun for me. I'm a lover, not a fighter!

gnome-restaurant-dialogue.text: If the player doesn't have the correct item in their inventory:

steps.text: Although you have found your customer you don't appear to have brought the correct food with you! You need [a/some] [ordered gnome food/drink item]!

gnome-restaurant-dialogue.text: If the player has a premade item in their inventory:

steps.text: Premade dishes will not do I'm afraid. Only hand made Gnome Cuisine is good enough for customers of Aluft Aloft.

gnome-restaurant-dialogue.text: If the player has the correct item in their inventory:

steps.text: You hand over your delivery of [a/some] [ordered gnome food item] to Captain Daerkin.

steps.npc: Excellent. Just what I need whilst watching the duels.

steps.text: If the reward is a gnome scarf:

steps.npc: Here you go, have a dashing pilot's scarf.

steps.text: You are given a gnome pilot's scarf as a tip.
If the reward is a pair of gnome goggles:

steps.npc: I have some spare goggles, you might as well have them.

steps.text: You are given a pair of pilot's goggles as a tip.
If the reward is anything else:

steps.npc: You must have had to travel a long way to get this to me. Here's a little something extra as a tip.

steps.text: You are given [a/some] [reward item(s)] as a tip.

gnome-restaurant-dialogue.text: If the player ran out of time:

steps.text: Your delivery is too late! Go back to Aluft jnr. to get another order. You discard your delivery box as you don't need it any more.
